cards.text: The LORD has just given Moses, Israel's leader, laws for everyday life and promises about the land ahead (Exodus 21-23). Now the LORD says to Moses, “Come up to the LORD…” And Moses isn't the only one invited.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses who's coming up the mountain with him. Who's on the list?

answers.text: Aaron with Nadab and Abihu plus seventy elders
Miriam with Jethro and Zipporah plus twelve leaders
Bezalel with Oholiab and Medad plus twelve spies

cards.text: Aaron is Moses' brother (Exodus 4:14), and Nadab and Abihu are Aaron's sons (Exodus 6:23). They're all invited, but the LORD has more to say about how close each one gets.

cards.question: The LORD invites Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu and seventy elders up the mountain. Who does He say may approach Him?
The people of Israel are allowed to go up the mountain with Moses.

cards.text: Aaron, Nadab, Abihu and the elders still get to come, but they're to worship at a distance. Friend, I'd be happy just to be on that guest list.
So Moses comes and tells the people ALL the words and ordinances of the LORD. ALL of them. I can't get through one cookie recipe without skipping straight to the oven temperature.

cards.question: Moses finishes telling the people all the LORD's words and ordinances. They all respond together that they will ___ all the words the LORD has spoken.

cards.text: Moses writes down all the words of the LORD, and EARLY the next morning he's up building an altar. No snooze button, no “five more minutes,” just a man with a job to do.

cards.question: Early in the morning, Moses builds an altar way up at the top of the mountain.
Next to the altar at the base of the mountain, Moses sets up pillars, one for each tribe of Israel. How many pillars?

cards.text: Altar's up, pillars are up, and now it's time for offerings to the LORD. Moses sends some people out to make them.

cards.question: Moses sends people out to make the offerings to the LORD. Who does he send?
The young men sacrifice young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.

cards.text: The young men offer burnt offerings too. Then Moses takes half of the blood and puts it in bowls.

cards.question: Half of the blood is in bowls. Moses splatters the other half on the ___.

cards.text: Then Moses takes the Book of the Covenant and reads it to the people. They answer, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”

cards.question: The people have made their promise, and half the blood is still in the bowls. What does Moses do with that blood now?

answers.text: He splatters it on the people
He pours it on the pillars
He burns it on the altar

cards.text: And Moses says, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.” I seal cookie boxes all day, friend, and NOTHING I seal comes close to this.
Now Moses goes up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel. Seventy-four people climbing a mountain, and I bet at least one of them asked if they were there yet.

cards.question: Moses and the leaders of Israel go up the mountain. What do they see?

cards.text: Under His feet is a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself. Meanwhile my bakery floor is flour and one chocolate chip I keep stepping on.

cards.question: These leaders were told to keep their distance. Now that they've seen God, He strikes them down.
The nobles of Israel have seen God, and they're still standing. What do they do there?

cards.text: Then the LORD tells Moses, “Come up to Me on the mountain and stay here…” He's going to give Moses tablets of stone with the law and commandments He has written.

cards.question: The LORD says the law and commandments on those stone tablets are written for the people's ___.
Moses sets out up the mountain of God, but not by himself. Who goes with him?

cards.text: Joshua led Israel's fight against the Amalekites (Exodus 17:10), and now he's going up the mountain with Moses. Before they go, Moses tells the elders, “Wait here for us until we return to you.”

cards.question: Moses is heading up the mountain. Who does he tell the elders to go to if anyone has a dispute?

cards.text: Hur is the one who helped Aaron hold up Moses' hands in a battle (Exodus 17:12). Moses just hung up the “manager on duty” sign and walked out the door.
When Moses goes up, the cloud covers the mountain and the glory of the LORD settles on Mount Sinai. For six days, the cloud covers it.

cards.question: On the seventh day, the LORD calls to Moses from within the cloud.
Earlier, the LORD came down on Mount Sinai in fire (Exodus 19:18). Now, to the Israelites watching below, the glory of the LORD looks like a consuming ___ on the mountaintop.

cards.text: And Moses walks right INTO the cloud as he goes up the mountain. Friend, I take two steps back every time I open my own oven door.

cards.question: Moses has gone up into the cloud. How long does he stay on the mountain?
